parameters.name: asana_pat
parameters.label: Asana Personal Access Token
parameters.helpText: Stored server-side by Zendesk and injected into Asana calls via the secure proxy; never visible in the browser. Leave blank for demo sample tasks.

parameters.name: asana_workspace_gid
parameters.label: Asana workspace GID
parameters.helpText: Required for live Asana. Leave blank to keep the Asana pane in demo mode.

parameters.name: asana_ticket_field_gid
parameters.label: Asana 'ticket ID' custom-field GID
parameters.helpText: If set, tasks are matched on this custom field's value = ticket number. If blank, full-text search of task name/description.

parameters.name: asana_project_gid
parameters.label: Asana request-form project GID
parameters.helpText: Where tasks created from the Asana > New request sub-tab land. Leave blank to use the project_gid in assets/asana_form_config.json.

parameters.name: asana_dedupe_days
parameters.label: Duplicate-check window (days)
parameters.helpText: The Asana > Other requests check and the submit-time duplicate warning look back this many days. Blank = 14.

parameters.name: slack_bot_token
parameters.label: Slack bot token (xoxb-…)
parameters.helpText: Needs chat:write + channels:history scopes and the bot invited to the channel. Optional extras: channels:read (+ groups:read) lights up the Channels sub-tab, bookmarks:read lets Workflows auto-discover links bookmarked in channels — without them those sub-tabs degrade gracefully. Injected server-side via the secure proxy; never visible in the browser.

parameters.name: slack_channel_id
parameters.label: Slack channel ID (C…)
parameters.helpText: The channel the ticket-sidebar Slack tab posts to. Leave blank to keep it in demo mode.

parameters.name: slack_workflow_links
parameters.label: Slack workflows (links)
parameters.helpText: Workflow link triggers shown in the Slack > Workflows sub-tab, 'Label|https://slack.com/shortcuts/…' entries separated by commas or newlines. The tab also auto-lists workflow links bookmarked in the posting/home channels (needs bookmarks:read). Launch opens the workflow's form in Slack; no ticket data is sent.

parameters.name: slack_search_token
parameters.label: Slack search token (user, optional)
parameters.helpText: A user token with search:read for the Workflows tab's request search (Slack's search API rejects bot tokens). Blank = search falls back to scanning recent history of the scoped channels. Injected server-side via the secure proxy; never visible in the browser.

parameters.name: asana_team_field_gid
parameters.label: Asana 'assigned team' custom-field GID
parameters.helpText: The home view groups Asana tasks by this enum field's value (Sales / Credentialing / Eligibility / Claims / Accounting…).

parameters.name: slack_channel_ids
parameters.label: Slack channels for the home view
parameters.helpText: Comma-separated channel IDs the bot is a member of, optionally labeled: 'C123:cx commons, C456:cx<>cat crossfunctional, C789:prod<>eng'. The home Slack tab scans these for threads tagged with your ticket ids.

parameters.name: guru_auth
parameters.label: Guru API auth (Basic)
parameters.helpText: Base64 of 'username:user-token' from Guru (User token = read/write). Injected server-side via the secure proxy; never visible in the browser. Generate: echo -n 'user:token' | base64.

parameters.name: guru_reason_field
parameters.label: Zendesk 'ticket reason code' field ID
parameters.helpText: The custom field whose value maps to a Guru card's tag. Set this (with guru_auth) to switch the Guru tab live; blank shows a sample card.

parameters.name: guru_suggest_subject
parameters.label: Guru: use ticket subject for suggestions
parameters.helpText: When enabled, the ticket's subject line is also sent to Guru as a search query to improve the Suggested tab. Off by default: the subject is requester-written text that would leave Zendesk.

parameters.name: guru_suggest_tags
parameters.label: Guru: use ticket tags for suggestions
parameters.helpText: When enabled, up to 5 ticket tags are sent to Guru as a search query to improve the Suggested tab. Off by default so the tag vocabulary doesn't leave Zendesk; with both toggles off only the reason-code value is sent (same as before).

parameters.name: guru_default_collection
parameters.label: Guru default collection ID (optional)
parameters.helpText: If set, Suggested and Search rank cards from this collection first, and Search preselects it as the filter.

parameters.name: guru_ai_answers
parameters.label: Guru: AI answers (Ask Guru)
parameters.helpText: Shows an AI answer with cited cards at the top of Suggested, seeded from the ticket's reason code (POST /v1/answers). Needs Guru AI enabled on your plan — if it isn't, the panel hides itself automatically. No new data leaves Zendesk beyond the reason code already sent to Guru search (subject only when 'use ticket subject' is on).

parameters.name: guru_agent_id
parameters.label: Guru Knowledge Agent ID (optional)
parameters.helpText: Scopes Ask-Guru answers to a specific Knowledge Agent. Leave blank to use the workspace default. Find IDs via GET /v1/assistants.

parameters.name: guru_debug
parameters.label: Guru: verbose debug logging (console + window.__guruDebug)
parameters.helpText: Troubleshooting only — leave OFF in normal use. When on (and Guru is in LIVE mode, i.e. guru_reason_field is set), prints each Guru request's method/path/subtype and the raw JSON response (status + error body on failure) to the browser console and keeps the last 50 entries on window.__guruDebug. Nothing prints in demo/sample mode. Responses (and search terms) can contain member free-text/PHI; the buffer lives only in the agent's browser session. The Guru API credential is never logged.

parameters.name: aht_field_map
parameters.label: Handle-time → ticket field map
parameters.helpText: Maps each app feature to a numeric Zendesk custom-field ID so Explore can report time-per-feature. Format: 'summary:25000,context:25001,asana_tasks:25002,asana_create:25003,asana_search:25004,slack:25005,guru:25006' — 'summary' is the landing tab, 'context' is the Account tab (key kept for existing installs). Digits only, no commas inside IDs. Invalid entries are skipped with a console warning. Blank = track only, write nothing.

parameters.name: aht_endpoint
parameters.label: Handle-time warehouse endpoint (optional)
parameters.helpText: URL of a collector that receives {ticket_id, agent, at, seq, idempotency_key, seconds:{feature:delta}} POSTs via the secure proxy. Also add its domain to domainWhitelist. Blank = no warehouse stream.

parameters.name: asana_status_buttons
parameters.label: Asana: Show ticket status buttons (On-hold / Pending)
parameters.helpText: When enabled, each Asana task card shows On-hold and Pending buttons so agents can update the linked Zendesk ticket status directly from the Asana section.

parameters.name: triage_field_map
parameters.label: Intelligent triage field IDs (optional; intent:ID,sentiment:ID,language:ID — blank auto-detects by field title)
